```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Librarias 
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #

library(tsibble)
library(lubridate)      # ymd()
library(dplyr)          # mutate()
library(feasts)         # para plots
library(fabletools)     # para test dickey 
library(ggplot2)
library(fable)          # para ajustar modelos
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Carga de datos 
# ------------------------------------------------------------- # 

# convierto Bimestre en formato Date
# convierto los datos en un data temporal donde bimestre es el indice temporal y el resto de las cols son series

d <- readxl::read_excel("Datos/agbarometerARG_enero2026.xlsx") |> 
  mutate(Bimestre = yearmonth(Bimestre)) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = Bimestre,
             regular = FALSE) 
  
```


# Descriptivo

## Ag Barometer

```{r}
d |> 
  autoplot(`Ag Barometer`) +
  labs(x = "Tiempo") +
  scale_x_yearmonth(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(20)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_bw()
```


## Los 3 índices

### Graficos de las series

```{r}
d |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Ag Barometer`, `Condiciones presentes`, `Expectativas futuras`), 
               names_to = "Índice", 
               values_to = "valor") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Bimestre, y = valor, color = Índice)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_yearmonth(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(20)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Ag Barometer" = "black",          
    "Condiciones presentes" = "#417B5A", 
    "Expectativas futuras" = "#FF88DC"  
  )) +
  labs(x = "Tiempo",
       y = "Índice") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") 
  
```




### Correlaciones entre los indices

```{r}
d |> 
  GGally::ggpairs(columns = 2:4)
```





## Estacionalidad

```{r}
d |> 
  gg_season(`Ag Barometer`, labels = 'left') +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_yearmonth(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.05))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 20)
  )
  

```

```{r}
d |> 
  # mutate(mes = month(Bimestre)) |> 
  # filter(!(mes %in% c(4,10))) |>  # haceme el prom(serie), excepto
  gg_subseries(`Ag Barometer`) +  # en abril y octubre
  theme_bw()
```




## Variancia

```{r}
d |> 
  mutate(anio = factor(year(Bimestre))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = anio,  y = `Ag Barometer`)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = 'Año') +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(20)) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Medidas de dispersion del agbarometer. 
# La dispersion de mis datos es cte a traves de t?

d |> 
  index_by(anio = year(Bimestre)) |> 
  group_by(anio) |> 
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Variancia = var(`Ag Barometer`),
    Rango = diff(range(`Ag Barometer`)),
    Rango_Intercuartilico = IQR(`Ag Barometer`)
  )
```


```{r}
# desvio vs media de la serie por anio

  d |> 
  index_by(anio = year(Bimestre)) |> 
  group_by(anio) |> 
  summarise(media = mean(`Ag Barometer`),
            desvio = sd(`Ag Barometer`)
  ) |> 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = media, y = desvio, label = anio) +
  geom_point(color = "#9984E1", size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +   # ajusta posición vertical
  labs(x = "Ag Barometer promedio",
       y = "Desvío del Ag Barometer") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
# calculo el lamda por no tenr variancia cte
lamda <- forecast::BoxCox.lambda(d$`Ag Barometer`)

# agrego una columna al data q es la serie transformada (transf box-cox)
```

## ACF AgBarometer

```{r}
d |> 
  ACF(`Ag Barometer`, lag_max = 60) |> 
  autoplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(0.2)) +
  labs(y = 'FACM',
       x = 'Retardo') +
  theme_bw()
```

## PACF AgBarometer

```{r}
d |> 
  PACF(`Ag Barometer`, lag_max = 60) |> 
  autoplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(0.2)) +
  labs(y = 'FACPM',
       x = 'Retardo') +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
d |> 
  features(`Ag Barometer`, unitroot_kpss)
```
# Dif regular orden 1 del AgBarometer

```{r}
# diferencia de primer orden
d |> 
  mutate(dif1 = difference(`Ag Barometer`)) |> 
  autoplot(dif1) +
  labs(x = "Tiempo") +
  scale_x_yearmonth(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(20)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_bw()
  
  

  
```
